connector.name: Kiwoom Securities MCP Server
connector.registryDescription: Read-only MCP server for the Kiwoom Securities REST API: market data, account inquiry, ISA tax tool
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package kiwoom-mcp-server. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the chunsam account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: KIWOOM_APP_KEY
env.description: Kiwoom REST API app key (issued at openapi.kiwoom.com; VIRTUAL and REAL need separate keys)

env.name: KIWOOM_MODE
env.description: VIRTUAL (모의투자, mock trading) or REAL (실전투자, live account)

env.name: ISA_ENABLED
env.description: Opt-in switch for the ISA tax-allowance tool (set true together with ISA_TYPE / ISA_OPENED_ON)
